extracted.name: Homemade Chicken Fettuccine
extracted.description: This chicken fettuccine Alfredo recipe is an easy, deliciously rich, creamy pasta, without added flour like other recipes. It is unique and versatile.
ingredient_lines: 3 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cut into chunks
instruction_lines: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Add fettuccine and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente; drain.

Meanwhile, heat butter in a large skillet and brown chicken and mushrooms until chicken is cooked through. Season with garlic salt and pepper. Add whipping cream and cook until thick, stirring constantly. Add Parmesan cheese when at desired consistency. Serve over noodles.
